title: Semantic Cross-Module Lineage
description: Summary of the safest cross-module MyERPPlus relationships for a readonly AI agent. Focuses on high-confidence relations, semantic boundaries, and cross-domain tracing patterns.

modules.name: master_data
modules.business_meaning: Cross-module foundation for contacts, items, branches, locations, projects, and other dimension labels.

modules.name: finance
modules.business_meaning: Used when the question moves into cash/bank, payment allocation, posted journals, or accounting impact.

modules.name: inventory
modules.business_meaning: Used when the question moves into stock, warehouse movement, transfer, receive stock, or adjustment.

modules.name: sales
modules.business_meaning: Sales commercial documents and operational receivable documents such as SO, DO, DR, SI, SR, AS, IC, and PV.

modules.name: pos
modules.business_meaning: Retail/POS transactions, promotions, vouchers, loyalty, and operational cashier flows.

high_confidence_relations.name: m5_sales_to_m1_contact
high_confidence_relations.business_meaning: Label customer pada dokumen sales diambil dari master contact.

high_confidence_relations.name: m5_sales_to_m1_item
high_confidence_relations.business_meaning: Label item pada line dokumen sales diambil dari master item.

high_confidence_relations.name: m12_pos_to_m1_contact
high_confidence_relations.business_meaning: Label customer/contact POS diambil dari master contact.

high_confidence_relations.name: m12_pos_to_m1_item
high_confidence_relations.business_meaning: Label item POS dan setup POS diambil dari master item.

high_confidence_relations.name: m12_pos_to_m5_sales_invoice
high_confidence_relations.business_meaning: POS voucher used on a formal sales invoice.

semantic_boundaries.name: m5_to_m2_finance_boundary
semantic_boundaries.guidance: Gunakan M5 sebagai anchor dokumen sales, lalu pindah ke M2 saat intent user sudah finance/accounting.
semantic_boundaries.anti_pattern: Jangan asumsi satu direct foreign key stabil M5 ke M2 jika source aktif tidak menunjukkannya.

semantic_boundaries.name: m5_to_m3_inventory_boundary
semantic_boundaries.guidance: Gunakan M5 sebagai anchor dokumen sales/logistik komersial, lalu pindah ke M3 saat intent user sudah inventory.
semantic_boundaries.anti_pattern: Jangan memaksa join langsung M5 ke M3 jika source aktif tidak menunjukkan FK stabil.

semantic_boundaries.name: m12_to_m2_finance_boundary
semantic_boundaries.guidance: Gunakan M12 untuk transaksi retail/POS, lalu pindah ke M2 saat intent user sudah finance/accounting.
semantic_boundaries.anti_pattern: Jangan asumsi satu direct foreign key stabil M12 ke M2 jika source aktif tidak menunjukkannya.

semantic_boundaries.name: m12_to_m3_inventory_boundary
semantic_boundaries.guidance: Gunakan M12 untuk transaksi retail dan item POS, lalu pindah ke M3 saat intent user sudah inventory.
semantic_boundaries.anti_pattern: Jangan asumsi satu direct foreign key stabil M12 ke M3 jika source aktif tidak menunjukkannya.

tracing_patterns.name: voucher_pos_to_formal_invoice
tracing_patterns.business_meaning: Menelusuri voucher POS ke invoice penjualan formal, lalu ke customer dan item master.

tracing_patterns.name: sales_invoice_to_master_labels
tracing_patterns.business_meaning: Menambahkan label customer dan item ke invoice penjualan.

tracing_patterns.name: sales_invoice_to_origin_documents
tracing_patterns.business_meaning: Menelusuri invoice penjualan ke dokumen asal di level detail.

tracing_patterns.name: pos_transaction_to_master_labels
tracing_patterns.business_meaning: Menambahkan label customer/contact dan item ke transaksi POS.

tracing_patterns.name: domain_switch_to_finance
steps: Tentukan anchor dokumen di M5 atau M12
Validasi bahwa intent user memang meminta accounting impact
tracing_patterns.business_meaning: Pola aman untuk berpindah dari domain commercial/retail ke domain finance.

tracing_patterns.name: domain_switch_to_inventory
steps: Tentukan anchor dokumen di M5 atau M12
Validasi bahwa intent user memang meminta stok atau mutasi gudang
tracing_patterns.business_meaning: Pola aman untuk berpindah dari domain commercial/retail ke domain inventory.

what_not_to_do: Jangan join M5 ke M2 hanya karena user menyebut invoice dan jurnal dalam satu kalimat.
Jangan join M12 ke M3 hanya karena user menyebut item dan stok tanpa memastikan intent inventory.
Jangan pakai M12 sebagai master barang utama; gunakan M1.
Jangan pakai M5 atau M12 untuk menebak posted journal jika M2 dibutuhkan.
Jangan membuat join header-ke-header lintas modul bila relasi stabilnya ada di detail atau hanya berupa semantic boundary.
recommended_agent_strategy: Pilih dulu domain utama pertanyaan: M5, M12, M3, atau M2.
Jika perlu label master, tarik M1.
Jika perlu accounting impact, pindah ke M2.
Jika perlu stok atau mutasi gudang, pindah ke M3.
Jika perlu relasi POS ke invoice formal, gunakan M12 -> M5.
